non-delivery.semantic_description: The user is complaining that they did not receive the product they ordered, or they received a completely different or wrong item.
law_sections: Section 2(11) - Deficiency in Service (Requires corpus verification)
non-delivery.action_suggested: Send legal notice, then file complaint at appropriate Consumer Commission.

defective goods.semantic_description: The user is complaining that a physical product they received is broken, damaged, malfunctioning, or not operating as expected.
defective goods.action_suggested: Request replacement/refund from seller, then file complaint.

deficiency in service.semantic_description: The user is complaining about a paid service that is unreliable, interrupted, poor quality, or halted. This applies to electricity, internet, telecom, transport, or repair services.
law_sections: Section 2(11) - Deficiency in Service (Requires corpus verification)
deficiency in service.action_suggested: Lodge complaint with the service provider's grievance officer, then file at Consumer Commission.

violated_rights: Right to Protection against Unfair Trade Practices
unfair trade practice.semantic_description: The user is complaining about deceptive pricing, being charged higher than displayed, hidden fees, dark patterns, or being charged for items they never agreed to.
law_sections: Section 2(47) - Unfair Trade Practice (Requires corpus verification)
unfair trade practice.action_suggested: File complaint highlighting unfair trade practice and request refund of unauthorized charges.

refund refusal.semantic_description: The user is complaining that a seller or platform is refusing to honor a return policy, refusing to give money back, or denying a refund request.
refund refusal.action_suggested: Issue legal notice for refund denial, then escalate.

violated_rights: Right to Protection against Unfair Trade Practices
misleading advertisement.semantic_description: The user is complaining that a seller or advertisement made false claims, deceptive promises, or the product features do not match what was advertised.

state.description: Between Rs. 50 Lakhs and Rs. 2 Crores
